WITH trader_type_counts AS (
  SELECT
    tr.tradekind,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ab.translink) AS analyzed_trade_count
  FROM advancedbehavior AS ab
  JOIN transactionrecord AS tx
    ON tx.transreg = ab.translink
  JOIN trader AS tr
    ON tr.tradereg = tx.trdref
  GROUP BY tr.tradekind
),
type_shares AS (
  SELECT
    tradekind,
    analyzed_trade_count,
    analyzed_trade_count::numeric / SUM(analyzed_trade_count) OVER () AS share_of_total
  FROM trader_type_counts
),
averages AS (
  SELECT AVG(analyzed_trade_count::numeric) AS average_count
  FROM type_shares
)
SELECT
  SUM(ts.analyzed_trade_count) AS combined_count,
  AVG(ts.share_of_total) AS average_share,
  AVG(ts.analyzed_trade_count - a.average_count) AS average_amount_above
FROM type_shares AS ts
CROSS JOIN averages AS a
WHERE ts.analyzed_trade_count > a.average_count;
